prerequisites: **pip & venv**: Recommended for creating an isolated virtual environment per sample directory.
run_instructions: Navigate to the target sample directory (for example, `cd secretmanager/v1/python/google-cloud-secret-manager`).
Create and activate a virtual environment, then install dependencies from `requirements.txt`.
Run the standalone Python sample script:
PYTHON.run_code_block:
cd secretmanager/v1/python/google-cloud-secret-manager
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python3 secret-manager-client-secrets-list.py
